stories.title: El Real Madrid golea al Rayo pero no engaña a nadie

en.title: Real Madrid thrashes Rayo but convinces no one
en.summary: Real Madrid defeated Rayo at the Bernabéu, yet the stadium's response suggested dissatisfaction with the team's performance despite the victory.

stories.title: "El cuerpo de mujer como campo de batalla" se hace con un acertado León de Oro de la mano de 'Woman Unknown', de la danesa May el-Toukhy

en.title: "The female body as a battlefield" wins the Golden Lion at Venice Film Festival with 'Woman Unknown' by Danish filmmaker May el-Toukhy
en.summary: May el-Toukhy's 'Woman Unknown' received the Golden Lion award at Venice, with el-Toukhy being the sole female director competing solo in the official competition. Lee Chang-Dong's 'Possible Love' won the Grand Jury Prize.

stories.title: El Festival de Venecia premia a la danesa 'Woman Unknown' con el León de Oro y España se va de vacío

en.title: Venice Film Festival awards 'Woman Unknown' the Golden Lion and Spain goes home empty-handed
en.summary: The Venice Film Festival closed its politically charged edition with 'Woman Unknown', directed by Egyptian-Danish filmmaker May el-Toukhy, winning the Golden Lion for a story about a nanny rebuilding her life after World War II.

stories.title: ‘Woman Unknown’, de May el-Toukhy, León de Oro en un Festival de Venecia marcado por la falta de directoras

en.title: 'Woman Unknown' by May el-Toukhy wins Golden Lion at Venice Film Festival marked by shortage of female directors
en.summary: May el-Toukhy's 'Woman Unknown' won the Golden Lion at Venice. 'Possible Love' by Lee Chang-dong received the Grand Jury Prize, 'DAU' by Ilya Khrzhanovskiy won Best Director, and 'NAZA' featuring Israeli soldiers' testimonies won the Special Jury Prize.

stories.title: Lando Norris deja su firma en la primera pole de Madring

en.title: Lando Norris leaves his mark on Madrid's first pole position
en.summary: Current F1 world champion Lando Norris secured the inaugural pole position at the Madrid circuit with a superior lap time, while Spanish drivers Sainz and Alonso faced difficulties due to penalties and early elimination.

stories.title: El Madring alumbra al mejor Lando Norris, que firma la primera ‘pole’ de la historia del circuito

en.title: Madrid brings out the best Lando Norris, who signs the first pole position in the circuit's history
en.summary: Lando Norris claimed the first pole position in Madrid's history as the reigning champion, demonstrating McLaren's improved performance since the Hungarian Grand Prix.

stories.title: El CEO de Anthropic dice que es necesario frenar el desarrollo de la IA y Altman (OpenAI) y Elon Musk le apoyan: «Podemos perder el control»

en.title: Anthropic CEO says AI development must be slowed and Altman (OpenAI) and Elon Musk support him: "We could lose control"
en.summary: Anthropic's CEO Dario Amodei advocates reducing artificial intelligence development speed to prevent capabilities from outpacing control systems, receiving support from OpenAI's Sam Altman and xAI's Elon Musk.

stories.title: El fervor por Céline Dion invade París ante su retorno a los escenarios

en.title: Fervor for Céline Dion invades Paris ahead of her return to the stage
en.summary: Céline Dion is returning to perform concerts in Paris this Saturday after pausing her music career in 2020 due to a neurological condition. The Canadian singer's comeback has generated significant anticipation in France, with 26 concerts planned at the Plenitude Arena in La Défense.

en.title: Norris takes first pole position at Madrid circuit
en.summary: The current world champion secured pole position by a narrow margin of 11 hundredths of a second over Kimi Antonelli.

stories.title: El CEO de Anthropic pide ralentizar el avance de la IA “antes de perder el control”

en.title: Anthropic CEO calls for slowing AI advancement "before losing control"
en.summary: Anthropic's CEO argues that AI systems are advancing faster than companies can understand them, warning that harmful effects could emerge within six to twelve months.

stories.title: Desastre español y 'vueltón' de Lando Norris para lograr la primera 'pole' de Madring: Sainz y Alonso, eliminados en la Q1

en.title: Spanish disaster and Lando Norris comeback to secure first Madrid pole: Sainz and Alonso eliminated in Q1
en.summary: Spanish drivers Sainz and Alonso were eliminated in Q1 qualifying and will start 17th and 18th respectively. British driver Lando Norris secured pole position by 11 thousandths of a second ahead of Antonelli, with Verstappen in third.
